title: WorkerGrid Stage 1: decouple worker/scheduler from PF into a separate component + /wg command surface
body: Separate WorkerGrid component (workergrid/, sibling of product-forge): wg.py CLI + client.py (producer API) + config.json + instructions.md (/wg instruct) + README. /wg command (project + global). Worker/scheduler/work/adapters/dispatch verbs MOVED out of /pf. Gates: wg_surface_check + updated pf_surface_check. See docs/WORKERGRID-DESIGN.md + ADR-0002.
